We are a global technology company with more than two decades of expertise in the Financial Services industry. Our mission is to enable financial institutions to become digital leaders by delivering world class customer journeys in digital and assisted channels. We develop omni-channel delivery, customer engagement (CRM), branch automation and loan origination solutions based on Microsoft technology (Azure, Dynamics 365, Power Platform) for banks and insurance companies worldwide.
With offices in 15 countries from Canada over Europe and the Middle East to Kuala Lumpur, our 900+ colleagues are serving customers in more than 30 countries worldwide.
r: Are you an experienced banking technology sales professional looking to make a meaningful impact at a growing FinTech company?

In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape VeriPark’s future by driving new business opportunities and building strong, long-term relationships with banks, credit unions, and other financial institutions.

Own the overall client relationship and commercial performance for an assigned portfolio of financial institutions, serving as the primary point of coordination between client stakeholders and VeriPark.
Develop a deep understanding of each client’s strategy, priorities, operating environment, technology landscape, desired outcomes and investment roadmap.
Build trusted relationships with executive sponsors, business leaders, technology stakeholders, procurement teams and day-to-day client contacts.
Develop and execute account growth plans that expand VeriPark’s footprint across business units, product lines, geographies and stakeholder groups within each client organization.
Proactively identify, qualify and pursue cross-sell, upsell and expansion opportunities based on evolving client priorities, strategic initiatives, technology roadmaps and organizational changes.

Apply cross-selling strategies such as expanding a CRM relationship into digital banking; introducing loan origination, customer onboarding, servicing or engagement capabilities to an existing digital banking client; extending a solution from one business line, subsidiary or region into others; and adding professional services, managed services, training, optimization or transformation engagements around deployed solutions.
Use successful implementations and measurable client outcomes to build internal advocacy, executive sponsorship and business cases for broader adoption of VeriPark solutions and services.

Partner with solution consultants, pre-sales, product specialists, delivery leaders and executives to shape value propositions, pursuit strategies, demonstrations and proposals, and to help close qualified expansion opportunities.
Maintain an active, well-qualified pipeline of expansion opportunities and provide accurate account-level growth forecasts and revenue projections.
Establish and maintain account plans, stakeholder maps, relationship goals, whitespace analyses and regular engagement cadences for each assigned client.
Lead periodic client reviews and executive business reviews covering outcomes, adoption, service performance, open priorities, risks, growth opportunities and forward plans.
Monitor client health and satisfaction, identify relationship or delivery risks early and coordinate timely resolution with delivery, support, product and leadership teams.
Act as the client’s advocate within VeriPark by communicating priorities, feedback and business needs to the appropriate internal teams.
Support clients in maximizing the value and adoption of VeriPark solutions, including digital banking, CRM and related services.
Own renewal planning and contract discussions, working to protect recurring revenue while identifying appropriate opportunities to broaden the relationship.
Maintain accurate client, renewal, relationship and opportunity information in VeriPark’s CRM, including activities, risks, commitments and forecasts.
Collaborate with Microsoft sellers, technology specialists and industry teams when joint engagement will benefit the client relationship or a qualified expansion initiative.
Represent VeriPark at relevant client meetings, industry events and conferences, with an emphasis on relationship development, client advocacy, account growth and market insight.

d: We are looking for AI Voice Recording Contributors to join an Arabic (Gulf) voice evaluation project and help support the development of the next generation of AI technologies.
Work Schedule: Flexible, task-based work (approximately 4–6 hours per day)
Help Shape the Future of AI

This short project offers an opportunity to contribute to the development and improvement of speech and language AI technologies by providing high-quality voice recordings in your native language and dialect.

You will complete recording tasks using our internal platform by reading provided text prompts aloud. The goal is to capture natural speech from native speakers of specific language variants to help improve AI systems' ability to understand diverse languages, dialects, and accents.
How Your Recordings Will Be Used

Your recordings will be used to evaluate how agents respond to spoken instructions and to compare that evaluation with an evaluation of text-based instructions. The collected audio may be reviewed for quality and incorporated into datasets used for research, development, testing, and improvement of AI systems.
q: Authentic pronunciation and strong familiarity with the target dialect or accent through everyday use
Advanced level of English to understand written instructions.
Ability to complete a trial voice recording to verify language variant and accent
Contributors must not imitate dialects or accents that are not their own
Experience with speech recording projects is an advantage, but not required
Strong communication skills and attention to detail
Ability to follow detailed instructions and maintain recording accuracy
Quiet room or recording space with minimal background noise
Computer microphone or headset with microphone
Ability to access and use an online recording platform
r: Read provided text cards aloud and record them exactly as written (there approximately 640 cards per person)
Produce clear, natural, and high-quality speech recordings following the guidelines and instructions provided
Speak using your natural dialect and accent
Ensure no words are added, omitted, or altered
Re-record submissions if requested to meet quality standards
Complete tasks using our internal recording platform
x: Opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge AI technology
Access to future language and AI-related projects
A flexible engagement ideal for gaining experience with AI data collection projects
When applying, please select the option that best describes your working status.
Are you a Freelancer or Private Individual?

A Freelancer is someone who has a business license and may have a VAT number or EIN for tax purposes. A VAT (Value Added Tax) number is a unique identifier assigned to a registered business in many countries; an EIN (Employer Identification Number) is a similar identifier used in the US. A Private Individual does not have a business license. If you aren’t sure, you are probably a private individual.

d: We Are Foodics! a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider. Founded in 2014 with headquarters in Riyadh and offices across 5 countries, including UAE, Egypt, Jordan and Kuwait. We are currently serving customers and partners in over 35 different countries worldwide. Our innovative products have successfully processed over 6 billion (yes, billion with a B) orders so far! making Foodics one of the most rapidly evolving SaaS companies to ever emerge from the MENA region. Also, Foodics has achieved three rounds of funding, with the latest raising $170 million in the largest SaaS funding round in MENA, boosting its innovation capabilities to better serve business owners.
q: 12-15+ years of relevant experience in FP&A, commercial finance, business finance or strategic finance, with meaningful
Professional qualification is mandatory: active CMA certification or CFA charter.

Demonstrated strong understanding of both SaaS and Fintech industries, including recurring-revenue economics, retention, churn, unit economics, payments economics, margins and the key operating drivers of technology-enabled financial services.
Demonstrated current and sophisticated use of Claude in day-to-day finance work; basic AI exposure is not sufficient.
Direct partnership with senior executives and experience presenting to Executive Committee / Board / investor audiences.
Advanced Excel / Google Sheets; BI, SQL, planning tool and finance automation experience are highly desirable.
r: Foodics is looking for a commercially minded, analytical and technology-forward finance leader to own the company's FP&A and Investor Relations . This is not a traditional budgeting and reporting role. The VP of FP&A and Investor Relations will be a strategic partner to the CFO, CEO, Board and leadership team — translating performance into decisions, challenging assumptions, improving forecast quality, managing the company's relationships with investors and stakeholders, and building a scalable, AI-enabled FP&A function across a business operating at the intersection of SaaS, fintech and payments.
Own annual budgeting, long-range planning, rolling forecasts and reforecast cycles, with clear full-year landing views and disciplined forecast accuracy.
Lead monthly performance reviews across revenue, ARR, gross profit, margins, EBITDA, OPEX, cash flow, headcount and key operating metrics.
Translate results into concise executive insights: what changed, why it changed, what it means, and what management should do next.
Build driver-based financial models and base / upside / downside scenarios to support strategic and operating decisions.
Act as senior finance partner to Commercial, Product, Technology, Operations and People teams, challenging assumptions and improving resource allocation.
Strengthen OPEX, headcount, CAPEX and strategic-investment governance, with clear ownership and accountability across the business.
Evaluate pricing, new products, geographic expansion, partnerships, major commercial initiatives and M&A opportunities through robust business cases and post-investment reviews.
Upgrade FP&A systems, reporting and automation so the function scales with Foodics and relies less on manual spreadsheet-heavy processes.
Serve as a key point of contact for existing and prospective investors, lenders and other external financial stakeholders.
Prepare Board decks, investor updates, quarterly/annual reporting packages and ad-hoc materials that clearly articulate company performance, strategy and outlook.
Manage the capital-raise narrative and supporting materials (data rooms, financial models, KPI packs) in partnership with the CFO/CEO during fundraising or strategic transactions.
Own the investor reporting calendar, ensuring timely, accurate and consistent communication of financial and operating results.
Track investor sentiment, market trends, comparable company performance and industry benchmarks relevant to SaaS/fintech/payments to inform positioning.
Coordinate due diligence processes with investors, auditors and advisors, ensuring data integrity and consistency across all external-facing materials.
Use Claude to accelerate performance analysis, scenario modelling, business cases and management commentary.
Interrogate large financial / operating datasets and identify drivers, anomalies, trends, risks and opportunities.
Create repeatable AI workflows or agents for recurring FP&A tasks and ad-hoc executive analysis.
Combine Claude with Excel / Google Sheets, BI tools, SQL, planning systems or other finance technology.
Define where AI should automate work, where human judgment remains essential, and how outputs should be validated
x: We believe you will love working at Foodics!
We offer highly competitive compensation packages, including bonuses and the potential for shares.
We prioritize personal development and offer regular training and an annual learning stipend to tackle new challenges and grow your career in a hyper-growth environment.
Join a talented team of over 30 nationalities working in 14 countries, and gain valuable experience in an exciting industry.
We offer autonomy, mentoring, and challenging goals that create incredible opportunities for both you and the company.
